notes.title: NEKO ODYSSEY(STEAM) Releasing Dec16!
notes.notes:
[h2]How many “likes” will you get on your posts?[/h2]

[h3]Introducing a cozy casual ADV all about taking cat pics,
“Neko Odyssey”(STEAM)!
DEMO content currently available.
Releasing Monday, December 16, 2024![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485568/0fc4e00fed298b348b103c1b457d8444859153c0.jpg[/img]

An update has also been made to the current playable DEMO.
A prologue where players can learn how Miki came to this island - an island with a secret - to live with her Aunt has been added. 
The game is being developed by “SECRET CHARACTER”, a games studio based in Bangkok, Thailand, known for games such as “Yakiniku Simulator” and “Bancho Tactics.”

Drawn with a charming, cozy touch, it shows the protagonist Miki, tired from walking around town, lying down to take a rest when she notices a cat’s tail peeking from the roof and decides to take a photograph of it.


[h3]【About the game】[/h3]
In Neko Odyssey, you get to spend time taking as many pictures as you want of various cats on Cat Island. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485568/330910066ad79058f7d95f8b39a17ee808a87a4e.gif[/img]

The protagonist Miki loves cats. Whenever a cute cat is spotted, take a picture of it on your phone and post it on SNS within the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485568/7d9bb351903214177b298ee2e17eece7bb05b912.gif[/img]

By getting many “Likes” and increasing your follower count, your followers may share some information about other cats you haven’t met before, or give you tips on how to take good pictures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485568/bac2e2e91a2567aedc564e7320f3687ac15f9c07.gif[/img]

Some cats won’t allow you to take a picture of them unless you gain their trust. Maybe you’ll even notice a secret hidden in the town as you snap pictures around the island.
Join Miki on a heartwarming adventure filled with discoveries, excitement and of course, cuteness!

[h3]●Screenshots (※Still under development)[/h3]

notes.title: This sidescroller combines cat photography with the joy (misery) of social media clout-farming
notes.notes:
One of my proudest pictures of a 2018 trip to Croatia wasn't of me and my pal. No, it wasn't of the beautiful scenery or the glistening sea either. It was of many cats lying in the sun together outside a little church. I hadn't seen that volume of cats in my life, nor that volume together in one spot, all hanging out. Now, you too can live this magic: there's a demo of this upcoming sidescroller called Neko Odyssey on Steam, and it consists of you taking photos of cats for internet clout. It's nice!

notes.title: DEMO ver of "Neko Odyssey" is available now!(STEAM NEXT FEST)
notes.notes:
DEMO ver is available now on STEAM NEXT FEST!
[previewyoutube=Lxl_cqlHXLo;full][/previewyoutube]


In the game, you'll have to search for cats in various locations throughout the town and take pictures to upload to social media (in game). 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485568/330910066ad79058f7d95f8b39a17ee808a87a4e.gif[/img]

Each photo you upload will earn likes from netizens. As you receive more likes, you'll become better known, and your followers may offer tips on finding new and different cat poses.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485568/7d9bb351903214177b298ee2e17eece7bb05b912.gif[/img]

During the cat photography sessions, some cats may require you to establish a connection with them before allowing you to photograph them. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44485568/bac2e2e91a2567aedc564e7320f3687ac15f9c07.gif[/img]

You'll also encounter certain events that will lead you to discover new photo opportunities.


In the DEMO version, you can explore a part of town, upload photos of cats you have taken to SNS, and enjoy the process of getting 200 followers. We hope you will give it a try!
